name: application-transaction-row
title: Transaction Row
description: Financial transaction list with a category icon, merchant, date/category meta, and a signed amount colored by credit vs. debit.
useWhen: Showing a list of financial transactions (purchases, payments, income) in a banking, expense-tracking, or billing context.
Each transaction benefits from a category icon for quick visual scanning alongside merchant and date.
Credit and debit amounts should be visually distinguished by sign and color, not just a plain number.
avoidWhen: You need sortable/filterable columns (running balance, reference number) — use `tables` for that denser, spreadsheet-like case instead.
There's no category concept — drop the icon and simplify to a plain merchant/date/amount row.
Amounts are always the same sign (e.g. only expenses) — the credit/debit color distinction adds no information in that case.
responsiveBehavior: Icon, merchant/meta, and amount sit in a single flex row with the middle column truncating; row height stays constant regardless of merchant name length.
accessibility: The amount's sign (+ or -) and color together convey credit vs. debit — the sign alone remains legible without color for colorblind or grayscale contexts.
Category icons are decorative; the category name is present as text in the meta line, not conveyed by icon alone.
Merchant names truncate visually but remain the full string in the DOM, so screen readers announce the complete name.

variants.title: Transaction Row
variants.description: Four transactions spanning software, housing, income, and groceries categories, with signed amounts.
accessibility: The credit/debit color and sign are both computed from a single signed amount value, so they can never disagree.

variants.title: Transaction Row (Dark)
variants.description: Transaction row list adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Category icon background/text colors and the credit amount color are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
